topics.title: Incidents
topics.subtitle: Enflite changes to Infor's Incidents form.
topics.summary: Incidents: Date Of Manufacture on the Unit tab and Product Code on the Reasons tab.

blocks.text: **Incidents** is Infor's form for customer service incidents. Enflite adds a **Date Of Manufacture** field on the **Unit** tab and shows the **General Reason** column as **Product Code** on the **Reasons** tab. These pages cover those two changes.
For every other field on the form, see [Infor's Incidents help](https://docs.infor.com/csi/latest/en-us/csbiolh/default.html?helpcontent=mergedProjects/fsp/forms/fstopics/Incidents.htm).

topics.title: Date Of Manufacture
topics.subtitle: Enflite field on the Incidents form
topics.summary: The date the unit was manufactured. It sits to the right of the Unit and Item descriptions on the **Unit** tab, and is also a column in the grid view.

blocks.text: **Not live yet.** This field is on hold until a walkthrough with the requester, which may change where the date is stored (on the incident or on the unit) or how it is filled in.
The date the unit was manufactured. It sits to the right of the Unit and Item descriptions on the **Unit** tab, and is also a column in the grid view.
Pick a date from the calendar or type it.

topics.title: Product Code
topics.subtitle: Relabelled column on the Incidents form
topics.summary: Infor's **General Reason** column on the **Reasons** tab, shown as **Product Code** at Enflite. Only the heading changed: the same codes and the same data as before.
